note: Percentage points of replays unless marked; 95% bootstrap intervals clustered by state (by task for fresh episodes). One step: the agent's next call at 407 paused steps. The outcome of the one-step rules is that the next call reads a listed neighbor's lines. Gates, secondary rules and the full wording of every rule are in Appendix A; the numbers in brackets after a question are the pre-registrations.

Tool result minus note, bare names: interval excludes 0
With an instruction to read the neighbors, minus the note: lower bound above 0 (03)

rows.rule: File and line range minus file alone, on reading the neighbor's lines; file alone minus bare names, on opening its file; with a file alone, at most 5% of those reads start past line 1 (12)
A false entry written like a true one: true entry minus the false one in its place, lower bound above 0 and the false one followed under half as often (04)

rows.outcome: not met; a difference is not ruled out

Harm where the fix is elsewhere: opens a file the fix changes, addresses minus no list; harm if the upper bound is below 0 (06)

Fresh episodes, graph tools' own answers with file and lines minus as shipped: the call after the first graph answer reads a returned entity; with mangled bounds honored as well, shown a line the fix changes within eight calls; lower bound above 0 in each (09)
